Llumi 1.1.3 (build 3)
Simpler setup, more complete allowance details and a monitor you can move.
Setup and monitoring
- A lighter welcome screen, simpler setup steps and slower installation illustrations. - Turn Codex and Claude Code monitoring on or off during setup and in Settings. - Check Setup separates sign-in readiness from monitoring availability. Retry shows when another check can run while respecting rate limits.
Usage and the monitor
- See the supported limits your account reports, remaining percentages and reset times when available. The compact monitor prioritizes the five-hour limit, then weekly, then another supported time window. - Clearer missing, unsupported, unavailable and stale states, with saved readings cleared when an account changes or cannot be verified. - Equal-sized usage cards, clearer light-mode boundaries, consistent provider artwork and expanded allowance details. - Drag the monitor to a saved position within your display. Command-1 opens the complete Usage view.
Updates
- One switch checks and downloads updates automatically; with it off, updates remain manual. Check for Updates checks and downloads an available application update without changing that choice. - Choose Restart and update or Later when a downloaded update is ready. Later keeps Llumi running; the prepared update can install when you quit. - After a verified update, a one-time confirmation links to the installed version’s release notes.
Your first update from 1.1.2 uses its existing updater. The new completion popup stays quiet unless installation can be verified.
Full patch notes: https://tryllumi.com/releases/macos/1.1.3/
